notes.title: Steam Achievements + Update
A Priest Walks Into a Graveyard Major Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello,

We've just released a new update for A Priest Walks Into a Graveyard!

This update was focused on changing the user interface of some scenes (menu, pause, introduction; specially adding universally-recognizable icons), the pathfinding behaviour of some enemies and... the [b]addition of two new hats to the pre-level selection[/b]! The first hat gives you +10 speed, and the second gives you +5 speed/+5 crosses, so these new hats are primarily focused on bringing more movement and speed to the player - if they choose to use these new hats. 

Some of the powerups icons were also changed in order to make them more easily recognizable as well.

Thanks for playing A Priest Walks Into a Graveyard. Have fun!
